test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which one of the following is a characteristic of the Green Revolution in India?

options.text: Considerable rise in the production of quantity of apples
Increased and appropriate application of chemical fertilizers for increasing agricultural production.
Collection of quality milk from members in rural areas;
Steady and assured supply of poultry products.

solution:
The correct answer is__ **Increased and appropriate application of chemical fertilizers for increasing agricultural production.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Increased and appropriate application of chemical fertilizers for increasing agricultural production is a characteristic of the Green Revolution in India.
 
• In India, the **Green Revolution** increased agricultural production, particularly in **Haryana, Punjab, and Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• The development of a high-yielding variety of wheat seeds and rust-resistant wheat strains were significant milestones in this project.
 
• New and high-yielding seed varieties are being introduced.
 
• Increased application of fertilizers, insecticides, and weedicides to reduce agricultural losses.
 
• Increased fertilizer application to boost agricultural productivity.
 
• Utilization of cutting-edge agricultural machineries such as tractors, seed drills, threshers, and harvesters.
 
• Use disease-resistant cultivars to increase productivity

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Golden Revolution is associated with honey production and horticulture.
 
• The White Revolution helped to alleviate poverty in India to a considerable extent.
 
• The poultry industry is linked to the Silver Revolution. It is a massive surge in egg or poultry output
